definitions: To become intertwined or enmeshed, often in a complicated or messy way.
To become involved in a confusing or difficult situation.
To become confused or muddled in thought or speech.
examples: The fishing line got tangled up in the seaweed.
He got tangled up in a legal dispute.
I always get tangled up when trying to explain complex ideas.
pastTenses: got tangled up, gotten tangled up
